title: cynorkis buchwaldiana subsp. braunii
intro: Cynorkis buchwaldiana subsp. braunii, commonly known as the Orchid of the forest floor, is a type of orchid plant belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It is native to tropical regions and is prized for its medicinal properties, which are said to offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Cynorkis buchwaldiana subsp. braunii, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antihistaminic, and anti-allergic properties. Additionally, this plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, pain, and respiratory issues.
